Hi Mateo / Vanessa,

Thanks for moving Olinda Paper Co. through the vendor activation checklist. A couple of items from our side as we prepare first invoices:

1) Portal vs email: Is Redwood requiring that we use the portal for all invoices, or is an email fallback allowed while our portal account is provisioned?

2) PO placement: should the PO number be embedded in the filename, the subject line, and the invoice CSV body? Which takes precedence for automated PO matching?

3) Multiline CSV: We do line-level VAT amounts and sometimes split lines across material/service rows. Do you have a sample CSV that supports nested line items and per-line tax columns (we attach our rough sample).

4) Multiple remit-to entities: We sometimes send invoices that must route to different payment entities depending on the PO. Any guidance for encoding remittance_entity in the file or subject?

Attached: sample_invoice_olinda_202506.csv (CSV stub)

If easier, we can hop on a 20-min call — we want to avoid a bunch of reworks on our first send.

Best,

Hi Sofia — thanks for the clear list and the sample. Short answers up front, then specifics and next steps.

TL;DR: Portal-first. Email is allowed as a temporary fallback but must include the canonical subject token and filename pattern for automatic ingestion. Use the CSV body for line-level tax/remit details.

Details:
- Portal: preferred (faster ACKs, idempotency, better PO matching). We expect suppliers to use the portal long-term.
- Email fallback: allowed while portal account is created. If using email, include the subject token exactly: "Redwood PO:<PO#> VendorID:<VID>". Also put PO and VendorID in filename: "<VendorID>_<PO#>_<invoice_date>.csv". If both exist, subject token will be used first for routing.
- CSV template: attached is our recommended template (redwood_invoice_template_v1.csv). It supports multiline rows via a 'line_group_id' column and per-line tax columns (tax_rate, tax_amount).
- Remittance: include a top-level 'remit_to_entity' field in the CSV header and, for email, add remit param in subject like "Remit:<entity_code>". If remit is ambiguous, our AP team will route manually which delays payment.

Next steps: 1) Use the attached template to produce a pilot invoice; 2) we will provision portal access within 3 business days; 3) schedule a 20-min onboarding call if you'd like a run-through.

Attachments: redwood_invoice_template_v1.csv (CSV)

I'll loop Kimberly to confirm the matching rules and the minimum required fields.

Thanks,
Mateo
Partner Onboarding
Redwood Inference

Hi Sofia — Kimberly from AP here. I want to confirm the production rules so Olinda can test cleanly.

Finalized ingestion rules (AP):
1) Primary match key = subject token. If subject token missing, we fallback to filename token parsing. If both missing, invoice will be placed in manual review queue.
2) Duplicate detection: we use a combination of VendorID + PO# + invoice_number + invoice_total to detect duplicates. If you resend with a different filename but same invoice_number & total, it will be flagged as duplicate and routed to the "potential duplicate" queue (no automatic payment). For testing, append ".TEST1" to invoice_number to force new ingest.
3) VAT format: numeric decimals only (e.g., 7.5). Do not include the % sign. Use tax_rate and tax_amount columns.
4) Required headers for CSV (exact column names): vendor_id, invoice_number, invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD), po_number, line_group_id, description, quantity, unit_price, tax_rate, tax_amount, line_total, remit_to_entity, currency. The template Mateo attached follows this naming.
5) Remit routing: remit_to_entity must match one of our enterprise remit codes (we'll provide a short mapping on the onboarding form). If absent, payment will default to the vendor's primary remit (may be incorrect).

We will also provision an SFTP drop for large-volume partners during onboarding; let us know if you want SFTP instead of portal.

Action items for Olinda:
- Reformat your sample to match the attached template and send a pilot via email using the subject token: "Redwood PO:<PO#> VendorID:OLINDA-789"
- If you want SFTP, reply with the primary SFTP contact and we will create credentials.
- Complete the vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (attached) and upload to the Drive link below.

Drive onboarding form: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-onboarding-form-id
Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (PDF)
